title: Releases page keeps itself current, and its checks fold into one line
why: Jason, 2026-11-18: 'release page needs to update to current states as releases are processed' and 'alerts and notices need to be cleared once fixed or changed'. System Configuration → Releases now looks again every 15 seconds while it's open (and when its tab is shown again): each release whose state or record changed is drawn again in place with its notices and checks, so a notice that no longer applies is gone; a new build appears at the top; what's open stays open; a card with a note being typed or a press still working waits for the next look. A press no longer reloads the page: its release is drawn again in place. Only js/admin-releases.js changes. FAQ: one entry. Also (Jason, 2026-11-18: 'once the notice has posted it can be removed/changed to a logged entry saving space and condensing under a log toggle'): each release's checks are one line under a toggle (all passed, or which failed), open only while a failed check waits on a person; a release that withdrew itself says so in one sentence, the details in its checks and What happened (app/admin/sections.php's Releases section and Releases::standing).

items: No new fatal errors in the logs

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
